invariants.name: NO_RAW_SHELL_EXECUTION
invariants.statement: Raw natural language user input is never executed via shell=True, os.system(), eval(), or Invoke-Expression.

invariants.name: SOLE_EXECUTION_CHOKEPOINT
invariants.statement: All consequential actions on the workstation pass strictly through ExecutionBroker.execute().

invariants.name: MODEL_NEVER_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY
invariants.statement: The LLM produces only TurnDecision proposals. Execution is authorized exclusively by ActionGate.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: ActionGate rule evaluation and RiskLevel enforcement

invariants.name: FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNREGISTERED_OR_BLOCKED
invariants.statement: Proposals requesting unregistered capabilities or blocked actions fail closed immediately.

invariants.name: AFFIRMATIVE_VERIFICATION_REQUIREMENT
invariants.statement: An artifact cannot be pinned or resolved across turns unless affirmatively verified by StepVerifier.

invariants.name: ZERO_PROCESS_ORPHAN_LEAKS
invariants.statement: Processes launched during operation or testing are tracked by PID in ResourceLedger and cleaned up.
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: ProcessTracker + Win32JobObject termination + explicit teardown guards
